relations.subject: fts:disable-file-transfer-rebalance
relations.evidence: Sets Search manager options. Note that only one setting is available: `disableFileTransferRebalance`.

relations.subject: fts:disable-file-transfer-rebalance
relations.reused_or_minted_predicate: reused (hasDefaultValue) - object is a literal, per the predicate's documented range
relations.evidence: If the value is false (the default), new Search Service partitions are created during rebalance by means of partition file transfer. If the value is true, partitions are created by means of partition build, from scratch, over DCP connections from the Data Service. **Default:** false

relations.subject: fts:disable-file-transfer-rebalance
relations.evidence: This is an Enterprise-only feature, which requires all Search Service nodes either to be running 7.1 or later; or to be running 7.0.2, with the feature explicitly switched on by means of this endpoint.

relations.subject: fts:disable-file-transfer-rebalance
relations.evidence: In 7.1+, by default, new partitions are created by the transfer of partition files from old nodes to new nodes: this significantly enhances performance.

notable_absence.finding: Unlike fts-rest-advanced/index.md (same round, same product), this page's Security section names only a generic 'Default' HTTP-basic tier with no specific role stated - just 'For more information, see Roles' - so no requiresServerRole relation can be captured here, even though this is plainly an admin-level cluster-configuration endpoint that would be expected to require role:fts-admin by analogy with the Manage-tier endpoints on the sibling API page.

cross_component_finding: This page also states a 7.0.2 exception not previously captured anywhere in the corpus: the file-transfer-rebalance behavior 'requires all Search Service nodes either to be running 7.1 or later; or to be running 7.0.2, with the feature explicitly switched on by means of this endpoint' - meaning on 7.0.2 specifically, file-transfer rebalance is opt-in via this same PUT /api/managerOptions call rather than the 7.1+ default-on behavior. No page in round 23's disableFileTransferRebalance record captured this version nuance since that page never quoted the 7.0.2 detail; recorded here as a finding rather than a third version-gated relation, to avoid overspecifying a detail the page itself treats as a passing caveat.
